display.purpose: Page titles and major section headers. Used sparingly — typically once per screen.

headline-large.purpose: Major block titles like '15-Day Forecast' or 'Air Quality'. Creates clear section divisions.

headline-medium.purpose: Card titles and prominent data points. The workhorse heading size.

body-medium.purpose: Standard body text. The most common size for labels, descriptions, and secondary information.

temperature-display.purpose: Oversized temperature numbers on main screens. Light weight prevents visual heaviness despite large size.

shadows.name: card-shadow
shadows.purpose: Standard elevation for Material cards in dark mode. Light mode uses 0.15 opacity.

shadows.name: dialog-shadow-layer-1
shadows.purpose: First layer of dialog shadow. Creates initial depth separation.

shadows.name: dialog-shadow-layer-2
shadows.purpose: Second layer of dialog shadow. Adds soft diffusion for realistic depth.

shadows.name: floating-island-shadow
shadows.purpose: Multi-layer shadow for floating action elements. Creates pronounced lift.

shadows.name: chart-point-shadow
shadows.purpose: Micro-shadow for chart data points. Extremely subtle separation from grid lines.

shadows.name: ai-card-glow
shadows.purpose: Amber glow shadow for AI feature cards. Creates distinctive visual signature.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and animations.

motion.name: ease-decelerate
motion.purpose: Entering animations where content slides in and settles.

motion.name: ease-accelerate
motion.purpose: Exiting animations where content accelerates away.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Quick micro-interactions like button press feedback.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard animation duration for page transitions and card expansions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Complex animations like weather condition transitions.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Phone portrait. Single column layout, 12px horizontal padding.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet portrait. Two column grid, 24px horizontal padding.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop and tablet landscape. Three column grid, 32px horizontal padding.

breakpoints.name: large-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Large desktop displays. Four column grid, 48px horizontal padding, max-width constraint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button using deep blue background. Used for primary actions like search, confirm, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #012d78; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #001A4D; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #000F2E; transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined button for secondary actions. Transparent background with blue border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #4A90E2; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #4A90E2; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.2); transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Default content container with semi-transparent background and border. Used for weather details, forecasts, and information blocks.
components.css: .ds-card-standard { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.21); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin: 8px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-card-standard h3 { color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; } .ds-card-standard p { color: #E8F4FD; font-size: 14px; margin: 0; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Compact Card
components.description: Reduced padding card for space-constrained scenarios. Same styling as standard but with 12px padding.
components.css: .ds-card-compact { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.21); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; margin: 8px; } .ds-card-compact span { color: #E8F4FD; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

components.name: AI Gradient Card
components.description: Special card for AI-generated content with amber gradient background and glow effect. Instantly identifies algorithmic insights.
components.html:
AI

Today will be warm with occasional clouds. Perfect for outdoor activities.
components.css: .ds-card-ai { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFB300 0%, #FFC947 50%, #FFE082 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.3); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin: 8px; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15); } .ds-ai-badge { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; background: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.9); color: #3E2723; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; } .ds-card-ai p { color: #3E2723; font-size: 14px; margin: 20px 0 0 0; line-height: 1.5; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Weather Condition Chip
components.description: Small pill-shaped chip displaying weather conditions or categories. Uses semantic colors for instant recognition.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #FFB74D; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Temperature Display
components.description: Large temperature number for main weather display. Light weight prevents visual heaviness at 48px size.
components.css: .ds-temp-display { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation Item
components.description: Navigation item in bottom bar. Shows icon and label with active/inactive states.
components.html: Today
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; color: #B8D9F5; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-active { color: #8edafc; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #E8F4FD; }

components.name: AQI Level Indicator
components.description: Color-coded air quality indicator following national standards. Green (excellent) to purple (severe).
components.css: .ds-aqi-excellent { background: #4CAF50; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-aqi-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; } .ds-aqi-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Life Index Grid Item
components.description: Grid item showing life activity indices (UV, car wash, dressing, etc.) with alternating semantic colors.
components.css: .ds-life-index { background: #FFB74D; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-life-icon { font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-life-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; } .ds-life-value { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'NotoSansSC', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
RainWeather is a sophisticated weather application that balances data density with visual clarity. The design philosophy centers on functional elegance — every visual element serves a purpose in communicating weather information quickly and accurately. The system embraces Material Design 3 principles while maintaining a distinct identity through its deep blue color palette and glassmorphic card treatments.

The interface prioritizes progressive disclosure: essential weather data appears immediately, while detailed insights unfold through interaction. This approach prevents cognitive overload while ensuring power users can access comprehensive meteorological data.

The aesthetic is calm but authoritative. Deep blues evoke trust and stability (appropriate for weather data), while amber accents highlight AI-generated insights and important alerts. The dark mode dominates the experience, reflecting the reality that users often check weather in low-light conditions (morning/evening).
keyCharacteristics: Data-first layout with clear visual hierarchy
Glassmorphic cards with subtle borders for depth without heavy shadows
Amber accent color reserved exclusively for AI features and critical alerts
Responsive grid system adapting from mobile to desktop seamlessly
Noto Sans SC font family for optimal Chinese character rendering
Fixed semantic colors for weather phenomena (sunny=gold, rain=blue, etc.)

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Weather phenomenon colors never change: sunny is always gold (#FFD54F), rain is always blue (#64B5F6), snow is always pale blue (#E1F5FE). Users build muscle memory for these associations — breaking them causes confusion.

rules.name: The AI Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber/gold colors (#FFB300 range) are reserved exclusively for AI-generated content. If it's not AI-generated, don't use amber. This creates instant visual distinction between algorithmic insights and raw data.

rules.name: The Contrast Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Text tertiary (#B8D9F5 dark / #6B7280 light) must maintain 4.5:1 contrast against its background. Never place tertiary text on colored card backgrounds without verification. When in doubt, elevate to text secondary.

rules.name: The Fixed Header Rule
rules.body: The weather header card (#0A1B3D) remains constant regardless of theme mode. This provides a stable visual anchor as users switch between light and dark themes.

rules.name: The Weight Progression Rule
rules.body: Font weights follow a strict progression: 300 (display numbers only), 400 (body text), 500 (interactive labels), 600 (headings), 700 (major headings). Never skip weights — this creates visual rhythm.

rules.name: The Line Height Rule
rules.body: Body text uses 1.5 line-height for comfortable reading. Headings compress to 1.2-1.3 for tighter visual grouping. Display numbers tighten further to 1.1. Never use single line-height (1.0) except for isolated numbers.

rules.name: The Letter Spacing Rule
rules.body: Large text (>24px) uses negative letter-spacing (-0.5px to -0.1px) to prevent loose, gappy appearance. Small text (<14px) uses positive letter-spacing (0.2px to 0.3px) to improve character separation. Body text at 14-16px uses minimal spacing (0.1px).

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only for: (1) Material Design Cards with explicit elevation, (2) Floating elements (FAB, action islands), (3) Modal dialogs. Standard content cards use borders, not shadows.

rules.name: The Shadow Intensity Rule
rules.body: Shadow opacity doubles in dark mode (30% vs 15%) because dark backgrounds absorb shadow visibility. A shadow that looks correct in light mode will disappear in dark mode without this adjustment.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: When defining card boundaries, prefer 1px borders over shadows. Borders are more reliable across different background colors and provide clearer visual separation in dense layouts.

dos: Do use the fixed weather header card color (#0A1B3D) for today's weather and city weather page headers, regardless of theme mode
Do reserve amber/gold colors (#FFB300 range) exclusively for AI-generated content
Do maintain semantic weather colors constant across themes: sunny=#FFD54F, cloudy=#BDBDBD, rainy=#64B5F6, snowy=#E1F5FE, foggy=#9E9E9E
Do use 8px border radius as the standard for cards and containers
Do apply 12px vertical spacing between cards (Material Design 3 minimum)
Do use Noto Sans SC (思源黑体) for all text
Do verify that text tertiary maintains 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background
Do use border-based depth (1px solid border) as the primary method for defining card boundaries
Do adapt shadow opacity to theme mode: 30% in dark mode, 15% in light mode
Do use the responsive breakpoint system: mobile (<600px), tablet (600-1023px), desktop (1024-1439px), large desktop (≥1440px)
donts: Don't use blue colors inside small cards on dark backgrounds — poor contrast against #0A1B3D
Don't place text tertiary on colored card backgrounds without verifying contrast
Don't nest cards inside cards — creates visual confusion and excessive depth
Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) as background colors
Don't change semantic weather colors based on theme
Don't use shadows as the primary method for card definition — prefer 1px borders
Don't use font sizes outside the established scale (11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 48px)
Don't apply amber colors to non-AI features
Don't use border-radius larger than 16px except for special cases
Don't ignore the screen horizontal padding (8px)
Don't use bounce or elastic easing for animations — use natural cubic-bezier curves
Don't place critical information below the fold on mobile devices
Don't use gray text on colored backgrounds without testing contrast
Don't mix theme-adaptive colors with fixed colors arbitrarily
